headline: 今日无新片，本周六部新片蓄势待发
headlineEn: No New Releases Today, Six New Films Ready This Week
summary: 2026年8月13日，今日无新片上映，本周共6部新片入市。《侠探杰克》《小黄人与大怪兽》领跑今日热度；周榜《奥德赛》居首，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》紧随其后。
summaryEn: On Aug 13, 2026, no films were released today, while six new films hit theaters this week. Jack Reacher and Minions & Monsters lead today's buzz; The Odyssey tops the weekly chart, followed by Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
